field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion records expected, observed, passed, and principle; separate completeness and value.
field_principles.canary_rows: Retain the producer reduction before independent replay.
field_principles.comparator_canary_ready_score: One means fixed transport and replay obligations pass, independent of decision accuracy.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify real device execution separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked work name upstream, exact field or check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Bind live calls to one owned RTX 3090 lease and task process.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_; retain the measured finding.
field_principles.inference_mode: Claim live_gpu only after task-owned CUDA generation starts.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation, not an invented task label.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use bounded generation, load-only, or the correct no-model class; never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.model_identity_receipt: Pin the current model revision, content hash, tokenizer, and embedded chat template.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.phase_spans: Keep measured phase costs disjoint and monotonic.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.raw_call_manifest: Retain all sixteen authentic calls, including invalid or truncated replies.
field_principles.readiness_receipt: Keep transport readiness separate from descriptive correctness.
field_principles.replay_discrepancies: A byte, request, response, or parser mismatch must remain visible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, input manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.request_grammar_rows: Bind requested grammar and settings to exact native request bytes.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.runner_receipt: Retain model identity, owned server process, GPU samples, launch settings, and invocation counts.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, and censored units and the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.semantic_accuracy_rows: Report descriptive development accuracy without making a held-out claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.timestamps: Retain actual UTC start and end observations.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash; do not hide failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict set. Oracle evidence cannot be positive, and only unfinished work is partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.
